name: inv-2-one-test-file-classifier
description: Whether a path is a test file is decided in one place: engine/src/core/test-file-classification.ts owns the engine default suffix list (DEFAULT_TEST_FILE_SUFFIXES) and the suffix match. I6's file_list split in the settlement helper, the implementation brief and the programmatic linter's test-file skip all import it, so the default list cannot drift between them (G4 slice 2, FR-013, FR-014). This rule refuses a re-declared suffix list (any binding named TEST_FILE_SUFFIXES; the owner's export is DEFAULT_TEST_FILE_SUFFIXES) and an ad-hoc endsWith('.test.'/'.spec.') check anywhere else.
fixHint: Import isTestFile / classifyTaskFiles (and DEFAULT_TEST_FILE_SUFFIXES) from engine/src/core/test-file-classification.ts instead of re-declaring a suffix list or matching suffixes inline.
